input_file.description: Path to the input SPIR-V binary file. Use '-' for stdin.

output_file.description: Path to the output file. If omitted, output goes to stdout.

vulkan_semantics.description: Emit Vulkan GLSL instead of plain GLSL.

reflect_mode.description: Emit JSON reflection instead of shader code.

entry_point.description: Name of the specific entry point to use.

stage.description: Force a specific shader stage (vert, frag, geom, tesc, tese, comp).

emit_line_directives.description: Aim to emit OpLine directives accurately in output code.

force_zero_initialized.description: Force temporary variables to be initialized to zero.

fixup_clipspace.description: Fixup Z clip-space at the end of a vertex shader.

flip_vert_y.description: Invert gl_Position.y (or equivalent) at the end of a vertex shader.

flatten_ubo.description: Emit UBOs as plain uniform arrays.

extensions.description: List of extension strings to add to GLSL output.

remove_unused_variables.description: Do not emit interface variables which are not statically accessed.

separate_shader_objects.description: Redeclare gl_PerVertex blocks for desktop GL separate shader objects.

emit_push_constant_as_ubo.description: Emit push constants as a UBO block.

emit_ubo_as_plain_uniforms.description: Emit UBOs as plain uniform structs.

combined_samplers_inherit.description: Inherit binding info from textures for combined image samplers.

no_nonzero_baseinstance.description: Assume base instance is always 0 for desktop GL.

pls_in_inputs.description: List of PLS input remaps. Items: {format: string, name: string}. Requires ESSL.

pls_out_outputs.description: List of PLS output remaps. Items: {format: string, name: string}. Requires ESSL.

remaps.description: List of variable remaps. Items: {source: string, target: string, components: number}.

no_420pack_extension.description: Do not use GL_ARB_shading_language_420pack in older GL targets.

remap_variable_types.description: List of variable type remaps. Items: {variable_name: string, new_type: string}.

force_flattened_io.description: Always flatten I/O blocks and structs.

msl_capture_output.description: Write geometry varyings to a buffer instead of stage-outputs.

msl_swizzle.description: Work around lack of support for VkImageView component swizzles.

msl_ios.description: Target iOS Metal instead of macOS Metal.

msl_pad_fragment.description: Always emit color outputs as 4-component variables.

msl_argument_buffers.description: Emit Indirect Argument buffers instead of plain bindings.

msl_texbuf_native.description: Enable native support for texel buffers.

msl_framebuffer_fetch.description: Implement subpass inputs with frame buffer fetch.

msl_emulate_cube.description: Emulate cube arrays with 2D array and manual math.

msl_discrete_descriptor_sets.description: List of descriptor set indices to implement without argument buffers.

msl_device_arg_buffers.description: List of descriptor set indices to use device address space for arg buffers.

msl_view_from_device.description: Treat the view index as the device index.

msl_dynamic_buffers.description: List of dynamic buffers. Items: {set_index: number, binding: number}.

msl_inline_uniform_blocks.description: List of inline uniform blocks. Items: {set_index: number, binding: number}.

msl_decoration_binding.description: Use SPIR-V bindings directly as MSL bindings.

msl_force_active_argbuf.description: Always emit resources which are part of argument buffers.

msl_force_native_arrays.description: Use plain native arrays instead of std::array.

msl_frag_output_mask.description: Mask to selectively enable fragment outputs.

msl_no_clip_dist_user_var.description: Do not emit user varyings to emulate gl_ClipDistance in fragment shaders.

msl_shader_inputs.description: List of shader input formats. Items: {index: number, format: string, size: number}.

msl_multi_patch_workgroup.description: Use new style tessellation control processing.

msl_vertex_for_tess.description: Mark vertex shader as one used with new-style tessellation.

msl_arrayed_subpass.description: Assume images of dimension SubpassData have multiple layers.

msl_r32ui_align.description: Required alignment of linear textures of format MTLPixelFormatR32Uint.

msl_r32ui_align_const_id.description: Function constant ID for linear texture alignment.

msl_tex_1d_as_2d.description: Emit Image variables of dimension Dim1D as texture2d.

msl_ios_simdgroup.description: Use simd_*() functions for subgroup ops.

msl_fixed_subgroup_size.description: Assign a constant size to the SubgroupSize builtin.

msl_force_sample_rate.description: Force fragment shaders to run per sample.

hlsl_enable_compat.description: Allow point size and point coord to be used in HLSL.

hlsl_support_basevertex.description: Support base vertex and base instance in HLSL.

hlsl_auto_bindings.description: List of resource types to auto-bind in HLSL (push, cbv, srv, uav, sampler, all).

hlsl_force_storage_as_uav.description: Always emit SSBOs as UAVs in HLSL.

hlsl_nonwritable_as_srv.description: Emit NonWritable storage images as SRV textures in HLSL.

hlsl_vertex_semantics.description: List of vertex input semantic overrides. Items: {location: number, semantic: string}.

hlsl_enable_16bit.description: Enables native use of half/int16_t/uint16_t in HLSL.

hlsl_flatten_matrix_semantics.description: Emits matrix vertex inputs with input semantics as independent vectors.

disable_storage_qualifier_deduction.description: Do not analyze usage for storage images without qualifiers.

flatten_multidim_arrays.description: Flatten multi-dimensional arrays to one dimension.

cpp_interface_name.description: Class name to emit in C++ codegen.
